scope: One preparation-specific human recovery comparison. No generic glucoraphanin or sulforaphane efficacy, clinical regimen, BUB1B/MVA benefit, original-queue credit or nomination replacement is established.

citation.title: Short-Term Effects of Broccoli-Derived Glucoraphanin on Recovery from Eccentric Muscle Damage: A Double-Blind Randomized Crossover Study

preparation.supplier: The Smarter Food Company, Norwich, UK
preparation.preparation: Freeze-dried powder dissolved in 125 mL boiling water, consumed hot/warm.

glucoraphanin_dose_as_reported.interpretation: Preserve μg; no inspected original supports correction to mg or μmol. Manufacturer confirmation is stated but no lot assay/certificate or validated concentration is supplied. High-dose label not independently validated.

preparation.schedule_methods: Once daily for six pre-exercise days, on day7 three hours before exercise, then daily for four post-exercise days.
preparation.schedule_abstract: Two weeks before exercise; inconsistent with detailed schedule.
preparation.washout: Stated 14-day washout; exercise section separately says next exercise after 14 days; exact period calendar not reconstructible.
preparation.control: Matched-appearance/preparation mixture of spinach, nettle, dill, parsley, carrot, onion and basil; full ingredient quantities and biochemical/nutrient matching unknown.
preparation.bioactivation_limit: Mustard inclusion does not establish active myrosinase after heating. Residual activity/microbial conversion and sulforaphane exposure were unmeasured.
preparation.target_engagement: No sulforaphane metabolites, Nrf2 target genes, direct oxidative stress assays or metabolism genotype measurements.
preparation.identity_boundary: Not purified glucoraphanin or sulforaphane; no equivalence to D,L-sulforaphane animal preparations or arbitrary broccoli foods.

design.reported_design: Double-blind randomized paired crossover with exercised/control arms
design.attrition: Two incomplete participants attributed to work duties; main/caption imply prior exclusion, native figure labels 17 randomized then 2 dropouts. Allocation and timing unresolved.
design.randomization: Reported independent researcher random-number generator for condition order.
design.masking: Participants and assessors reportedly masked; identical sealed sachets; success not evaluated.
design.exercise: Six sets of ten maximal voluntary eccentric elbow-flexor contractions at 60 degrees/second; alternate arm at second period.
design.arm_assignment_inconsistency: Section 2.2/protocols say dominant arm first; Section 2.3/protocol exercise section says randomly selected arm.
design.control_arm_limit: Same person and systemic preparation; second-period control is previously exercised arm if stated switch followed.
design.crossover_limit: No period/sequence/dominance or treatment-by-period output reported. Baseline null does not exclude response carryover or contralateral repeated-bout adaptation. Washout is not proof that exercise adaptation disappeared.
design.workload: Comparable work asserted but numeric values omitted.
design.adherence: Daily logs/sachet counts exceed 95% for all completers; no biochemical confirmation.
design.diet: Maintain usual diet; retrospective crucifer survey reported low stable intake; total diet not controlled.

analysis.primary_model: Three-way repeated-measures Time(Pre,Post,48h,96h) × Supplement(X,Y) × Arm(exercised,control), all designated within-person; CK/soreness Time × Supplement.
analysis.checks_reported: Shapiro-Wilk normality, Mauchly sphericity, Greenhouse-Geisser corrections as needed.
analysis.multiplicity: Bonferroni time-pair post hoc comparisons; no complete across-outcome family control described.
analysis.hierarchy: Main/protocols no single primary or confirmatory gate. Registry lists torque/ROM/girth primary and soreness/CK secondary, omits ultrasound hierarchy and has other design errors.
analysis.feasibility_sample: Target around 15 completers; reported post hoc sensitivity at alpha .05/power .80 for partial eta² around.06.
analysis.effect_size_claim_limit: Method reports Time×Supplement eta²<.05; torque Results broader bound <.105 for listed nonsignificant interactions. No exact treatment differences/CI or full ANOVA degrees of freedom. Null and post hoc sensitivity do not demonstrate equivalence or exclusion of clinically relevant effects.

conclusion: No demonstrated improvement of 96-hour recovery for this hot-water broccoli/mustard preparation under severe eccentric loading in 15 healthy men. Dose identity/exposure, crossover analysis, registry chronology and reporting inconsistencies limit inference. No generic sulforaphane failure, equivalence, MVA benefit or nomination change follows.
match_aliases: Cesanelli 2026 hot-water broccoli and mustard powder
identity_limit: The sole descriptive alias identifies the Cesanelli 2026 study preparation: 10 g freeze-dried 99.5% broccoli/0.5% mustard-seed powder supplied by The Smarter Food Company and reconstituted in 125 mL boiling water. It is not a generic glucoraphanin, sulforaphane/SFN, broccoli, mustard, extract or current retail-product alias. Manufacturer-reported glucoraphanin content and consumption do not establish measured sulforaphane exposure or equivalence to separate D,L-sulforaphane preparations.

source_and_review_provenance.primary_reading_depth: Complete original scientific main and all eight captions/native figures; complete text of both five-page protocol/SAP versions; all five native v2 protocol pages; complete current registry. source_and_review_provenance.independent_reading_depth: Accepted independent review of complete retained main and all eight captions/native figures, both complete five-page protocol texts and current registry; native v2 protocol pages 1, 2 and 5 only. Native v1 pages and v2 pages 3/4 were not independently inspected; no fresh retrieval, raw data or statistical replay.
